svg.title: Why size saves two bytes in the same four-color band
svg.desc: Mobile comparison of the same four-color band. Auto and fast preserve mask holes in a 25-byte body; size paints solid amber and pink blocks, repairs blue and green, and uses 23 bytes.
svg.text: The same four-color band from Figure 1.
All four masks retain their holes.
Blue and green safely repair the temporary overdraw.
